name: course

lines.text: Okay, watch this. I'm just typing what I need to study: AP Bio, photosynthesis.
Memora's Agent drafts the whole course outline in seconds.
Hit proceed, and it writes every single lesson.
Proper notes, equations, even flashcards built right in.
And every topic gets its own section, all the way to photorespiration.
One prompt. A whole course. Link's in bio.

_doc: Each line starts at <anchor event> + offset seconds (clip time). A line with end_at instead ENDS at rec_end + offset. tools/place_vo.py resolves these against the recording's events.json.
